unlisted_practices: EHR-grounded patient-specific knowledge graphs to simulate multi-turn physician-patient consultations for LLM evaluation
Process-based evaluation of consultation workflow (questioning, information integration, handling ambiguity) beyond final-answer accuracy

screen.reason: The study develops and applies a multi-turn patient simulation benchmark (AIPatient Arena) to evaluate LLM performance in end-to-end clinical consultation workflows, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
